build.buildCommand: rm -rf bootstrap/cache/* && composer install --ignore-platform-reqs --no-scripts && touch database/database.sqlite

deploy.startCommand: rm -rf bootstrap/cache/* && php artisan config:clear && php artisan cache:clear && php artisan package:discover --ansi && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan storage:link && php -S 0.0.0.0:$PORT -t public
